description: This file is a JSON schema/API description for the 'System' plugin in a device management system. It defines the API endpoints, events, and data structures used to manage system-level features such as firmware updates, power states, device information, and environmental data.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Collects device details such as MAC addresses, firmware version, and other hardware info. Deprecated, use updated APIs.

methods.name: getDownloadedFirmwareInfo
methods.description: Provides details about current and downloaded firmware versions and location.

methods.name: getFirmwareDownloadPercent
methods.description: Returns the current percentage of firmware download progress.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpdateInfo
methods.description: Checks for available firmware updates and related info.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpdateState
methods.description: Checks the current state of a firmware update process.

methods.name: getLastFirmwareFailureReason
methods.description: Retrieves the reason for the last firmware upgrade failure.

methods.name: getLastWakeupKeyCode
methods.description: Returns the last keycode that woke the device.

methods.name: getMacAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves all relevant MAC addresses (Ethernet, WiFi, Bluetooth, etc.).

methods.name: getMfgSerialNumber
methods.description: Provides the manufacturing serial number of the device.

methods.name: getNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Returns whether WakeOnLAN/WLAN is supported.

methods.name: getPlatformConfiguration
methods.description: Provides device support features and account info based on query.

methods.name: getPowerState
methods.description: Returns current power state of the device (ON, STANDBY, etc.).

methods.name: getPowerStateBeforeReboot
methods.description: Returns power state prior to reboot.

methods.name: getSerialNumber
methods.description: Returns device serial number.

methods.name: getSystemVersions
methods.description: Provides system firmware and receiver versions.

methods.name: getFriendlyName
methods.description: Retrieves the user-set friendly name of the device.

methods.name: getTerritory
methods.description: Gets current system territory and region.

methods.name: getTimeZones
methods.description: Lists available time zones for the device.

methods.name: getTimeZoneDST
methods.description: Gets current configured time zone and DST info.

methods.name: getWakeupReason
methods.description: Provides the reason for waking from deep sleep.

methods.name: isOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Checks if telemetry data collection is opted out.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Requests device reboot with specified reason.

methods.name: requestSystemUptime
methods.description: Returns the system uptime in seconds.

methods.name: setDeepSleepTimer
methods.description: Sets timer for deep sleep mode.

methods.name: setFirmwareAutoReboot
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic reboot after firmware update.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets device operational mode (NORMAL, EAS, WAREHOUSE) for a duration.

methods.name: setNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Enables or disables network standby mode.

methods.name: setOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Sets telemetry data collection opt-out.

methods.name: setPowerState
methods.description: Sets device power state (ON, STANDBY).

methods.name: setFriendlyName
methods.description: Assigns a user-friendly name to device.

methods.name: setBootLoaderSplashScreen
methods.description: Configures the splash screen during device startup.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Retrieves the build type of the flashed image.

methods.name: setTerritory
methods.description: Updates system territory and region.

methods.name: setTimeZoneDST
methods.description: Configures system time zone and DST settings.

methods.name: setWakeupSrcConfiguration
methods.description: Configures wakeup sources, deprecated in favor of new API.

methods.name: updateFirmware
methods.description: Starts firmware update process.

methods.name: uploadLogsAsync
methods.description: Begins background logs upload.

methods.name: abortLogUpload
methods.description: Stops ongoing logs upload process.
